policy: Every registered API/tool plus every *_RESEARCH_CAPABILITY.json extension is re-evaluated on every DOOMSDAY forecast. Availability alone may identify relevant workstreams but does not change ETA. ETA changes require a runtime-verified capability plus a verified doomsday_forecast impact receipt. For the same row calibrated capability multipliers do not stack by default; the strongest single verified factor is used unless a future joint benchmark explicitly defines a combined factor.

calibrated_impact_contract.location: A capability file may include doomsday_forecast.impacts[]
calibrated_impact_contract.rule: The capability itself must also be runtime verified. Unverified capabilities cannot accelerate the forecast even if an impact object is present.
calibrated_impact_contract.blocker_multiplier: Use DOOMSDAY_EVENTS.jsonl for blockers/rework rather than a capability acceleration field.
calibrated_impact_contract.stacking: Strongest single verified capability multiplier per forecast row by default; no blind multiplication across providers.
